modules.name: 2OPFM
modules.description: Two-operator FM voice after the Super Synthesis 2OPFM, with the stock firmware emulated and five alternative firmwares.

modules.name: PHRSR
modules.description: Two 16-step phrases recorded live from one knob, after the Super Synthesis PHRSR, ported from its firmware.

modules.name: SVFs
modules.description: Two state-variable filters on a 2164, after the Super Synthesis SVFs, modelled from its schematic: 1V/oct, self-oscillating, zener-limited.

modules.name: EG
modules.description: A fast analog attack/decay envelope after the Super Synthesis EG, modelled from its schematic: OTA core, one-shot or re-trigger, end-of-cycle out.

modules.name: VCAs
modules.description: Four linear 2164 VCAs that chain into a mixer, after the Super Synthesis VCAs, modelled from its schematic.

modules.name: SCANNER
modules.description: The CV half of a 4-way crossfader after the Super Synthesis SCANNER: one scan voltage, four overlapping windows.

modules.name: TVCA
modules.description: A two-input OTA VCA with tanh distortion, after the Super Synthesis TVCA, modelled from its schematic.

modules.name: CHORUS
modules.description: A modulated delay line with feedback, after the Super Synthesis CHORUS, ported from its firmware: chorus to 300 ms delay.

modules.name: ROOM
modules.description: An allpass reverb after the Super Synthesis ROOM, ported from its firmware: one shared buffer, filtered inverted feedback, dry/wet slider.

modules.name: OTAVCAs
modules.description: Two saturating LM13700 VCAs with attenuverted CV, after an unreleased Super Synthesis design, modelled from its schematic.

modules.name: S&H
modules.description: Three chained JFET sample-and-holds after an unreleased Super Synthesis design: one trigger samples on its rise, the next on its fall.

modules.name: PNGBL
modules.description: A pingable OTA state-variable filter after an unreleased Super Synthesis design, modelled from its schematic (provisional panel).
